raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 스타일이 확연히 다르게 느껴지면 좋겠어. 레이아웃은 각 스타일과 읽기 흐름에 맞게 선택하고, 잘 작동하는 구도는 여러 시안에서 공유해도 돼. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

Subsequently read copy from the displayed native rasters and judged the displayed usage and thumbnail rasters. procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio critic; no spawn, fork, resume, peer review, producer self-inspection or unlisted embedded-path access. Verified the exact pinned document bytes; read packet, case, review rules, rubric, recording README/addendum/adapter and ratio policy, then read all five pinned native-evidence manifests and verified the exact image pins and PNG dimensions. The packet has no source assets and no protected layouts. Actually opened and visually inspected, using tools.view_image detail original and image emission detail original, M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320 and M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320: all 15 exact poster views preceded the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. Usage views are 720×405, thumbnails 320×180; native dimensions are those in the packet. Retained 60 actual first copy readings in packet-entry order. Afterwards opened exactly M1 native once for the date/hour spacing uncertainties and M2 native once for the hour spacing uncertainty; these did not resolve meaningful spaces versus glyph side bearings, and both readings remain. No crops, substituted assets, generated/edited views, invented opening events or runtime session IDs. Scores judge visible execution; evidence does not assert invisible maker intent. This procedure is my semantic attestation, not a claim that helpers proved visual inspection.

emotion_control.observation: The high contrast and energetic handling gestures communicate cheerful participation; a restricted three-color structure controls the intensity without flattening the expressive print language.

ai_slop.location: hand/leaf contact and lower-right pot grip
ai_slop.observation: The gestures have clear targets; leaf veins follow leaf contours, pot rims contain visible soil and graphic scratches remain attached to object surfaces. No unexplained symbol or contradictory construction is apparent.

content_form.observation: The cutaway establishes a specific care concept by showing the normally hidden root system while keeping the home plant and human hand visible. It grounds the care/repotting message in the plant itself.

hierarchy.location: large foliage/roots at left, title and numerical block at right
hierarchy.observation: The plant and title are balanced entry points. The slogan leads into explanation, with date/hours/place acting as the next clear information group and access/care/invitation/URL below.
The botanical silhouette and root panel remain recognizable even when detailed copy recedes.

typography.location: four-line serif paragraph on pink and practical text below place
typography.observation: The delicate serif strokes and small plum supporting text are legible with attention but lose weight at usage size. The title and date retain much stronger definition, leaving a weak optical bridge to the long explanation and care guide.
The refined serif theme fits the drawing, but the very large title near the right edge and lightly weighted paragraph are not equally finished as a complete reading system.

space.location: left botanical spread, root pot and right aligned blocks
space.observation: The broad foliage, grounded cutaway pot and common right-column inset give the page controlled balance. The hand enters from the left and the root panel anchors the lower part; paragraph and logistics have distinct gaps.

image_material.location: leaf veins, petioles, hand and root section
image_material.observation: Fine line contours, translucent pink/lilac shading and soil/root detail maintain a coherent drawn language. The exposed pot section reads as a diagrammatic convention; the hand at the rim and roots remain locally legible.

emotion_control.observation: Gentle color and close plant attention communicate patient curiosity and care. The exposed roots give the softness a concrete subject rather than decorative sentiment alone.

ai_slop.location: root panel, pot rim, fingers and leaf edges
ai_slop.observation: Roots stay within the exposed soil region and petioles connect into the plant; pot boundary and hand contact are understandable. Fine texture follows material areas rather than becoming arbitrary floating ornament. No specific anatomical failure is established.

residuals: Thin serif explanation and small supporting copy are less comfortable at usage720 than the strong title and date, despite remaining transcribable at native.
The root cutaway is a legible artistic convention; this pixel review does not establish botanical or biological accuracy.
The title/date/footer system and mirrored plant/copy arrangement remain close to the rest of the set.
Native 1672×941 is accepted by nearest-integer-single-edge rounding: height is 0.5 px above 1672×9/16. It is not mathematically exact 16:9.

evidence.location: cyan copy-left/photo-grid-right system
evidence.observation: Small pot, leaf macro and large tree give a sunny retail/home view. M3 exchanges the sides and makes the photos monochrome/process-focused, yet the image-grid/large-gothic-title/serif-date/info-footer system remains close. M4 also repeats this type hierarchy.

evidence.location: blue painted field, left serif title and right watering action
evidence.observation: The full-bleed arm/can diagonal and blue/orange contrast make this more active and pictorial than M1/M3. Nevertheless its title/slogan/paragraph/date/hours/place/footer ladder and right-side hand/plant hero proportions recur in M4; its serif-title approach has a softer counterpart in M5.

evidence.location: monochrome photo bands left and gothic copy right
evidence.observation: Root handling and the finished pot communicate a documentary care process, unlike M1's display/macro selection collage. But mirrored placement, similar photo-grid division and the same gothic/sans/serif-number mixture leave the two as related photographic systems rather than strongly independent complete directions.

evidence.location: yellow/purple/orange plant silhouettes with left gothic info stack
evidence.observation: Flat cut-like marks and the two handling gestures produce a forceful graphic mood. The title and serif date are nearly the same type-role treatment as M1; the plant-right/copy-left mass and unchanged logistical grouping repeat M2. It is not just a palette swap, but its full organization is still highly related.

evidence.location: pink botanical cutaway left and delicate serif copy right
evidence.observation: The exposed roots, fine contours and soft shadows supply a specific quiet care subject and a clear contrast with M4's bold plant silhouettes. Its right-column title/Latin/slogan/paragraph/date/hours/place/access/care/invitation/URL ladder, however, is the same repeated system seen in M3 and a mirror of M2. Thin supporting type changes tone more than information organization.

evidence.location: relationship of all five information systems
evidence.observation: All five carry almost the same top-small-market-label, huge-title, Latin-line, bold-or-serif-slogan, ordinary explanatory block, large-serif-date, hours/place and lower practical footer proportions. Shared layouts and text-role order are permitted; the score of 3 reflects the combined recurrence of typographic contrasts, proportional rhythm and generic plant-versus-copy staging after counting actual scene, color, viewpoint and mood differences, not a demand for five unique layouts.

residuals: There is meaningful scene and mood variation: presentation/leaf detail, watering, root handling, plant inspection and cutaway roots. This is more than five color filters, but the repeated complete information-and-hero system prevents a strong five-direction diversity score.
All five remain in the record. Strong local image execution in M2/M3/M4 does not average away M1/M5 typography or the set diversity of 3.
M1 date/hour and M2 hour meaningful-space fidelity remains NA after the permitted single native revisits; no replacement or inferred copy resolves it.
